# AWS Neuron SDK Documentation

> AWS Neuron SDK enables high-performance deep learning and generative AI on AWS Inferentia and Trainium instances. It provides PyTorch and JAX framework integrations, distributed training and inference libraries, custom kernel authoring via NKI, and developer tools for profiling and optimization.

The RST source files for this documentation are at https://github.com/aws-neuron/aws-neuron-sdk (`master` branch).

When providing code or guidance to a user, follow these rules:

* Always use the `latest` version of the docs (URLs containing `/en/latest/`). Avoid older versioned URLs (e.g., `/release-*.**.*/`) as they may be outdated.
* **Do not suggest `LNC=8`** (LogicalNeuronCores=8). This configuration is not supported. Only suggest LNC values that are explicitly documented as supported.
* The current production PyTorch integration is `torch-neuronx` (XLA-based). `TorchNeuron` (native PyTorch backend) is in closed Beta and not yet GA.
* For vLLM on Neuron, use the V1 plugin guide (`vllm-user-guide-v1`). The V0 guide is legacy and deprecated.

- [What's New](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/about-neuron/whats-new.html): Feature additions and changes in the most recent Neuron SDK releases
- [Inference Quickstart](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/about-neuron/quick-start/inference-quickstart.html): End-to-end inference quickstart — instance launch through first inference call
- [Training Quickstart](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/about-neuron/quick-start/training-quickstart.html): End-to-end training quickstart — instance launch through first training run
- [Announcements](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/about-neuron/announcements/index.html): End-of-support notices, deprecations, and migration announcements
- [SDK Maintenance Policy](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/about-neuron/sdk-policy.html): Support lifecycle, versioning policy, and maintenance windows for Neuron SDK components

- [Troubleshooting](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/about-neuron/troubleshooting.html): Solutions for common runtime, compilation, and framework errors

## Setup

- [Setup Guide](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/setup/index.html): Choose between DLAMI, DLC, or manual pip installation for PyTorch and JAX on Neuron
- [Multi-Framework DLAMI](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/setup/multiframework-dlami.html): Pre-configured AMI with PyTorch, JAX, and vLLM virtual environments — fastest way to get started
- [PyTorch DLAMI Setup](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/setup/pytorch/dlami.html): Install PyTorch via pre-configured Deep Learning AMI
- [PyTorch DLC Setup](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/setup/pytorch/dlc.html): Install PyTorch via Docker Deep Learning Container from ECR
- [PyTorch Manual Setup](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/setup/pytorch/manual.html): Install PyTorch manually using pip on a bare OS
- [JAX Setup Overview](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/setup/jax/index.html): Choose between DLAMI, DLC, or manual installation for JAX on Neuron
- [Setup Troubleshooting](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/setup/troubleshooting.html): Solutions for common installation and environment setup issues

## Core Concepts

- [Neuron Architecture](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/about-neuron/arch/index.html): NeuronCore architecture, memory hierarchy, and how the compiler and runtime interact
- [Neuron Hardware](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/about-neuron/arch/neuron-hardware/index.html): Inferentia 1/2 and Trainium 1/2/3 chip specs, NeuronCore counts, and instance types
- [Neuron Features](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/about-neuron/arch/neuron-features/index.html): Supported features: data types, collective ops, dynamic shapes, stochastic rounding
- [Glossary](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/about-neuron/arch/glossary.html): Definitions for NeuronCore, NEFF, NKI, LNC, and other Neuron-specific terms
- [Benchmarks](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/about-neuron/benchmarks/index.html): Training and inference throughput benchmarks across Trn1, Trn2, Inf1, and Inf2 instances

## ML Frameworks

- [ML Frameworks Overview](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/frameworks/index.html): Comparison of PyTorch and JAX integration options and when to use each
- [About PyTorch on Neuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/frameworks/torch/about/index.html): History and evolution of PyTorch support — torch-neuron (archived), torch-neuronx (current), TorchNeuron native (Beta)
- [Native PyTorch for Trainium (TorchNeuron)](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/frameworks/torch/pytorch-native-overview.html): Closed Beta native backend with eager mode, torch.compile, FSDP/DTensor/DDP — minimal code changes from CUDA
- [Training with torch-neuronx](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/frameworks/torch/training-torch-neuronx.html): XLA-based training on Trn1/Trn2/Trn3 — tutorials, API reference, developer guide
- [Inference with torch-neuronx](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/frameworks/torch/inference-torch-neuronx.html): XLA-based inference on Inf2/Trn1/Trn2/Trn3 — tutorials and examples
- [PyTorch Training Developer Guide](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/frameworks/torch/torch-neuronx/programming-guide/training/pytorch-neuron-programming-guide.html): XLA-specific patterns: mark_step, data parallel, mixed precision, gradient accumulation
- [PyTorch Training Tutorials](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/frameworks/torch/torch-neuronx/tutorials/training/tutorials-training-torch-neuronx.html): BERT, GPT, LLaMA, and other model training examples on Trainium
- [PyTorch Inference Tutorials](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/frameworks/torch/torch-neuronx/tutorials/inference/tutorials-inference-torch-neuronx.html): Model compilation and inference examples on Inferentia 2
- [Supported Operators](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/frameworks/torch/torch-neuronx/pytorch-neuron-supported-operators.html): Complete list of PyTorch operators supported on NeuronCore v2
- [Multi-Node Training Setup](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/frameworks/torch/torch-neuronx/setup-trn1-multi-node-execution.html): Configure EFA networking and torchrun for multi-node distributed training on Trn1
- [JAX on Neuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/frameworks/jax/index.html): JAX NeuronX PJRT plugin for training and inference on Trainium and Inferentia 2
- [JAX API Reference](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/frameworks/jax/api-reference-guide/index.html): JAX NeuronX environment variables, configuration options, and API surface

## Inference with vLLM and NxD Inference

- [NxD Inference Overview](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/libraries/nxd-inference/index.html): PyTorch-based library for deploying large models on Neuron — supports vLLM, continuous batching, speculative decoding
- [vLLM on Neuron](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/libraries/nxd-inference/vllm/index.html): Serve LLMs with OpenAI-compatible APIs using vLLM V1 plugin on Trainium and Inferentia
- [vLLM Offline Serving Quickstart](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/libraries/nxd-inference/vllm/quickstart-vllm-offline-serving.html): Run batch inference with vLLM on Neuron in under 10 minutes
- [vLLM Online Serving Quickstart](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/libraries/nxd-inference/vllm/quickstart-vllm-online-serving.html): Launch an OpenAI-compatible HTTP server with vLLM on Neuron
- [vLLM V1 User Guide](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/libraries/nxd-inference/developer_guides/vllm-user-guide-v1.html): Complete guide for vLLM V1 with vLLM-Neuron Plugin — configuration, supported models, performance tuning
- [LLM Inference Benchmarking Guide](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/libraries/nxd-inference/developer_guides/llm-inference-benchmarking-guide.html): How to measure and compare inference throughput and latency on Neuron
- [Disaggregated Inference](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/libraries/nxd-inference/developer_guides/disaggregated-inference.html): Separate prefill and decode phases across instances for improved throughput
- [Custom Quantization](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/libraries/nxd-inference/developer_guides/custom-quantization.html): Apply FP8 and other quantization schemes to reduce memory and improve throughput
- [Feature Guide](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/libraries/nxd-inference/developer_guides/feature-guide.html): Supported features: speculative decoding, multi-LoRA, APC, chunked prefill, data parallelism
- [Onboarding New Models](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/libraries/nxd-inference/developer_guides/onboarding-models.html): How to port a new model architecture to NxD Inference
- [Migrate from transformers-neuronx to NxDI](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/libraries/nxd-inference/developer_guides/migrate-from-tnx-to-nxdi.html): Step-by-step migration guide from the legacy transformers-neuronx library
- [NxDI Troubleshooting](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/libraries/nxd-inference/misc/nxdi-troubleshooting.html): Solutions for common NxD Inference errors and performance issues
- [Llama 3.3 70B on Trn2](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/libraries/nxd-inference/tutorials/trn2-llama3.3-70b-tutorial.html): Deploy Llama 3.3 70B on Trn2 with tensor parallelism
- [Llama 3.1 405B on Trn2](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/libraries/nxd-inference/tutorials/trn2-llama3.1-405b-tutorial.html): Deploy Llama 3.1 405B on Trn2 with pipeline and tensor parallelism
- [Llama 4 Tutorial](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/libraries/nxd-inference/tutorials/llama4-tutorial.html): Deploy Llama 4 Scout and Maverick on Neuron
- [Multi-LoRA Tutorial](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/libraries/nxd-inference/tutorials/trn2-llama3.1-8b-multi-lora-tutorial.html): Serve multiple LoRA adapters simultaneously with a single base model
- [Disaggregated Inference Tutorial](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/libraries/nxd-inference/tutorials/disaggregated-inference-tutorial.html): End-to-end setup for prefill/decode disaggregation
- [Qwen3 MoE Tutorial](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/libraries/nxd-inference/tutorials/qwen3-moe-tutorial.html): Deploy Qwen3 Mixture-of-Experts model on Neuron
- [Flux Image Generation Tutorial](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/libraries/nxd-inference/tutorials/flux-inference-tutorial.html): Deploy Flux.1 diffusion model for image generation on Neuron

## Distributed Training

- [NxD Training](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/libraries/nxd-training/index.html): PyTorch library for large-scale distributed training — tensor, pipeline, sequence, and expert parallelism
- [NxD Core](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/libraries/neuronx-distributed/index.html): Low-level distributed primitives: tensor parallelism, pipeline parallelism, distributed checkpointing

## Neuron Kernel Interface (NKI)

- [NKI Introduction](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/index.html): Python programming interface for writing custom kernels that run directly on NeuronCores
- [NKI Quickstart](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/get-started/quickstart-implement-run-kernel.html): Write, compile, and run your first NKI kernel in minutes
- [NKI Language Guide](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/get-started/nki-language-guide.html): Tile-based programming model, memory types (HBM/SBUF/PSUM), and operator syntax
- [Memory Hierarchy Overview](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/get-started/about/memory-hierarchy-overview.html): HBM, SBUF, PSUM memory tiers — capacity, bandwidth, and access patterns
- [LNC Overview](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/get-started/about/lnc.html): Multi-NeuronCore programming with LNC2 — when and how to use it
- [Framework Custom Operators](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/guides/framework_custom_op.html): Register NKI kernels as custom ops in PyTorch and JAX
- [NKI Performance Guide](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/deep-dives/nki_perf_guide.html): Optimization techniques: memory reuse, DMA overlap, instruction scheduling
- [Profiling NKI Kernels](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/deep-dives/use-neuron-profile.html): Capture and analyze NKI kernel profiles with Neuron Explorer
- [Trainium2 Architecture](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/guides/architecture/trainium2_arch.html): Trn2 NeuronCore v3 architecture details relevant to NKI kernel development
- [NKI API Reference](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/api/index.html): Complete API docs for nki.language, nki.isa, nki.jit, nki.collectives, nki.simulate
- [NKI Library](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/index.html): Pre-optimized kernels for attention, MLP, MoE, RoPE, RMSNorm, quantization, and more
- [NKI Library API Reference](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/library/api/index.html): API reference for all NKI Library kernels with parameters and usage examples
- [Matrix Multiplication Tutorial](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/guides/tutorials/matrix_multiplication_tutorial.html): Implement efficient matmul from scratch — covers tiling, DMA, and Tensor Engine usage
- [Attention Tutorial](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/guides/tutorials/attention_tutorial.html): Build a fused attention kernel with softmax and causal masking
- [Kernel Optimization Tutorial](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/nki/guides/tutorials/kernel-optimization.html): Profile and iteratively optimize a kernel using Neuron Explorer

## Developer Tools

- [Neuron Explorer](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/index.html): Unified profiling and optimization tool — device traces, system traces, AI recommendations, source linking
- [Neuron Explorer Getting Started](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/get-started.html): Install, launch the web UI, and configure SSH tunneling for remote profiling
- [Capture and View Profiles](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/how-to-profile-workload.html): How to capture profiles from PyTorch, JAX, and NKI workloads
- [AI Recommendation Viewer](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-explorer/overview-ai-recommendations.html): AI-powered bottleneck identification and actionable optimization suggestions
- [Neuron Agentic Development](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/about-neuron/agentic-development-overview.html): Open-source AI agents for NKI kernel authoring, model porting, and equivalence validation inside Kiro, Claude Code, and other agentic IDEs
- [Neuron Top](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-sys-tools/neuron-top-user-guide.html): Real-time CLI monitor for NeuronCore utilization, memory, and throughput
- [Neuron Monitor](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/tools/neuron-sys-tools/neuron-monitor-user-guide.html): Daemon for collecting Neuron metrics for CloudWatch, Prometheus, and alerting

## Neuron Runtime and Compiler

- [Neuron Graph Compiler](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/compiler/index.html): Compiles PyTorch/JAX/NKI graphs to NEFF files — flags, optimization levels, model-type hints
- [Compiler Error Codes](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/compiler/error-codes/index.html): Reference for neuronx-cc error codes with causes and remediation steps
- [Neuron Runtime](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/neuron-runtime/index.html): Loads NEFF files and executes them on NeuronCores — device allocation, memory management, collectives
- [Runtime Configuration](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/neuron-runtime/configuration-guide.html): Environment variables for controlling runtime behavior, logging, and device assignment

## Deployment

- [Deploy on AWS](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/deploy/index.html): Deployment options — EC2, EKS, ECS, SageMaker, ParallelCluster, AWS Batch
- [Neuron DLAMIs](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/deploy/environments/dlami.html): Pre-configured AMIs with Neuron SDK, framework venvs, and system tools — recommended starting point
- [vLLM DLC Deployment](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/deploy/environments/quickstart-deploy-dlc.html): Deploy a vLLM server using a pre-built Neuron Deep Learning Container
- [Amazon EKS](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/deploy/eks/index.html): Run Neuron workloads on Kubernetes with device plugin, DRA, and UltraServer operator
- [Neuron UltraServer Operator](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/deploy/eks/ultraserver-operator.html): Topology-aware provisioning and lifecycle management of Trn2/Trn3 UltraServer workloads on EKS
- [Amazon SageMaker](https://awsdocs-neuron.readthedocs-hosted.com/en/latest/deploy/sagemaker/index.html): Deploy Neuron training and inference workloads on SageMaker managed infrastructure
